# A hand-assembled fixture for script format version 2. No live capture in
# this format exists yet, so this is not a verbatim trace the way
# trace-real-excerpt.txt is: it is built from two real records of the same
# run, joined on the one number that reads the same in both of them.
#
# The monotonic time, pid, tid, cgroup, generation-start and path columns,
# and every value on them, are copied verbatim from a real host trace
# (bpftrace v0.25.0, kernel 6.6, script format version 1, 2026-09-13). That
# trace predates the ns_pid/ns_tid columns, so they are not in it; the
# values used for them here are the container-side process numbers the
# same run's own independent occurrence log recorded for the same process
# generation, identified by the generation start time in clock ticks —
# 29256421 for curl (host pid 3013915, container pid 3010380) and
# 29256441 for git (host pid 3013995, container pid 3010460).
